awaiting.title: All done — waiting for the selection
awaiting.body: You have done everything from your side: every video and both tests. Once the selection process is finalised, you will be told if you are selected for face-to-face training.

message.formative: Complete all required videos in Phase 1 before this test goes live. If you wish, you can also go ahead and watch the Phase 3 add-on videos in advance.
message.screening: Complete all add-on videos to become eligible for this test. While you wait, feel free to go back and revise the previous videos.
message.default: Complete all required videos to become eligible for this test.
message.selected: You have been selected for face-to-face training.
message.announced: Done — the selection results have been announced.
message.formativeDone: This score is for your own reference — the formative test does not decide the selection. See above which topics to revise.
message.screeningDone: You have submitted this test. Once the selection process is finalised, you will be told if you are selected for face-to-face training.

weakPassword.body: Your password is easy to guess. You can keep it, but choosing a harder one keeps your mothers' records safer.

rings.testsHint: Formative test (FT) on top, screening test (ST) below

progress.pctTitle: % of the expected forms that were filled
progress.sundays: Each date shows its weekday (M T W T F S S). Sundays are greyed: no visits are expected on them, so a low bar there is not poor work.

team.title: My batch — who needs a call
team.subtitle: The learners you are batch monitor for, lowest forms first.

modes.noWork: Your adoption work appears here once your project's programme calendar is set.

status.notSelected: Training complete. The selection results are out — you were not selected this time.

topics.subtitle: What you knew well, and what to watch again.

selection.selectedTitle: Congratulations — you are selected for face-to-face training!
selection.selectedBody: You finished every video and passed your tests. Adoptions is now open: register your mothers and fill their forms there.
selection.notSelectedBody: Thank you for completing every video and test. You were not selected for the face-to-face training this time. The videos stay open for you to revise.

delivery.title: Has the delivery happened?
delivery.body: Ask this first. From 35 weeks every pregnancy visit starts with this question.
delivery.yesHint: Register the baby, then the growth check, breastfeeding and the mother's protein form.
delivery.noHint: Fill the pregnancy check and the protein form as usual. Ask again at the next visit.

protocol.hidden_other: {{count}} breastfeeding points are done well and are not asked again.

bf.active: Breastfeeding form: at every visit for now.
bf.reopened: Breastfeeding form needed again: the baby's weight-for-age fell.
bf.stopped: Breastfeeding is going well: no breastfeeding form for now.
bf.not_breastfeeding: The mother is not breastfeeding: no breastfeeding form.

pf.stopped: The mother eats enough protein: no more protein forms.

protocol.notBreastfeeding: The mother is not breastfeeding. There is no breastfeeding form until she restarts.

counsel.title: The mother is not breastfeeding
counsel.body: Counsel her today to restart breastfeeding. Then mark it here.

counselled.title: Counselled on {{date}}
counselled.body_one: Check breastfeeding at the next visits. {{count}} visit since the counselling.
counselled.body_other: Check breastfeeding at the next visits. {{count}} visits since the counselling.

dropOut.title: Breastfeeding still stopped
dropOut.body: She was still not breastfeeding at 2 visits after the counselling. If she will not restart, confirm the adoption as a drop-out.
dropOut.confirmBody: {{mother}} and her baby will leave your visit list. Today's date and your name are recorded.

protocol.droppedOutBy: Confirmed by {{name}}. No more visits are planned.
protocol.failed: Could not save. Check the connection and try again.

progressInfo.title: How your progress is counted
progressInfo.intro: Videos count for 60 points and the tests you pass for 40 points.
